external_entities.name: shoppers
external_entities.description: People who browse the storefront, sign in, and place orders.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Shoppers browse the storefront and place orders through the storefront API.

external_entities.name: card processor
external_entities.description: Third-party payment processor that sends payment settlement webhooks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our card processor is a third party.

processes.name: storefront API
processes.description: Node service running on Cloud Run that exposes the storefront, accepts orders, and receives payment webhooks.
processes.source_excerpt: the storefront API, a Node service running on Cloud Run

processes.name: order service
processes.description: Python worker that processes orders and accesses the orders database and receipt archive.
processes.source_excerpt: The order service is a Python worker in our core network

data_stores.name: orders-db
data_stores.description: PostgreSQL database containing orders, shopper addresses, and card-last-four values.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Orders, shopper addresses and card-last-four live in a PostgreSQL database (orders-db)

data_stores.name: receipt archive
data_stores.description: Cloud Storage bucket containing receipts recording which order was written and that the order service wrote it.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Cloud Storage bucket we call the receipt archive

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.source_excerpt: Shoppers sign in with email and password and get a session cookie
data_flows.notes: MFA has not been rolled out for shopper accounts.

data_flows.name: place orders
data_flows.source_excerpt: Shoppers browse the storefront and place orders through the storefront API.

data_flows.name: submit order
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a shopper submits an order the storefront API calls the order service over gRPC.

data_flows.name: read-write orders
data_flows.source_excerpt: the order service reads and writes with a single application account that has full read/write
data_flows.notes: The password comes from an environment variable on the worker.

data_flows.name: write receipt
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every completed order also gets a receipt written to a Cloud Storage bucket
data_flows.data_description: receipt recording the order written and the order service

data_flows.name: settlement webhook
data_flows.source_excerpt: After they settle a payment they POST a webhook back to the storefront API to tell us the order is paid.
data_flows.notes: The source says: "I would have to check how that callback is authenticated."

trust_boundaries.name: core network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the order service runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The order service is a Python worker in our core network

assumptions.assumption: The orders database contains confidential data because it stores shopper addresses and card-last-four values.
assumptions.basis: The source states that orders-db stores shopper addresses and card-last-four values.

assumptions.assumption: The receipt archive contains confidential data because it stores payment-related order receipts.
assumptions.basis: The source states that every completed order produces a receipt in the receipt archive.
